description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different anomaly detection models, measured by the Area Under the Curve (AUC), as a function of the number of data points (N). The x-axis, labeled "N," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)," is also linear and ranges from 75% to 100%, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot features five lines, each representing a different model. The blue line, marked with circles, starts at an AUC of approximately 95% at N=0 and ends at an AUC of about 100% at N=20. The orange line, marked with squares, begins at an AUC of around 90% and ends at an AUC of about 95%. The green line, marked with stars, starts at an AUC of approximately 85% and ends at an AUC of about 90%. The red line, marked with triangles, begins at an AUC of around 80% and ends at an AUC of about 85%. The purple line, marked with diamonds, starts at an AUC of approximately 80% and ends at an AUC of about 80%. The plot shows that all models improve in performance as the number of data points increases, with the blue line showing the highest performance throughout the range.
